headline: AL activists throw eggs at Hasnat Abdullah during London visit
summary: Protests erupted in East London as Awami League supporters targeted National Citizen Party leader Hasnat Abdullah with eggs and chases.
details: Awami League activists in the UK staged protests around a venue in East London where National Citizen Party (NCP) leader and MP Hasnat Abdullah was scheduled to attend a meeting.
The event was organized by the NCP at a banquet hall behind the East London Mosque in Whitechapel, but protests by expatriate AL supporters and affiliated groups broke out upon news of his arrival.
Reports indicate that earlier in the day, around noon near Elephant Park in East London, AL activists reportedly chased Hasnat Abdullah and threw eggs at him.
Police were deployed to the area as crowds gathered, with NCP supporters also positioning themselves nearby, leading to intermittent chants from both sides.
The meeting was scheduled to begin at 6pm local time, but Hasnat Abdullah had not arrived by 7:50pm as police maintained order in the area.

headline: 3 arrested after child raped and thrown into Kangsa river in Mymensingh
summary: Police have detained three young men following the recovery of a child's body from the river after an alleged gang rape.
details: Three young men have been arrested in Mymensingh on allegations of gang-raping a child and throwing her body into the Kangsa river.
The victim's body was recovered from the river, leading to the police investigation and subsequent arrests.
Local authorities are currently interrogating the suspects to determine the full sequence of events and identify any other accomplices.
The incident has sparked outrage in the local community, calling for swift justice for the young victim.
